Products

Control, protect, and verify AI execution.

Three focused products form a trust and execution layer between AI systems and the data, tools, and infrastructure they use.

Current capability

Hyper Tern

Hyper Tern mediates AI requests before execution. It helps organizations decide which identity may use which model, tool, resource, and action.

  • Request routing and approved model selection
  • Identity, permission, and policy checks
  • Tool and resource access control
  • Explicit boundaries for downstream actions
Current capability

Hyper-ABS

Hyper-ABS protects sensitive information before it reaches a model. It helps reduce unnecessary data exposure while preserving the context required for an approved task.

  • Masking and redaction
  • Tokenization and abstraction
  • Policy-aligned transformations before inference
  • Controlled reconstruction only at approved boundaries
Current capability

Hyper-0x

Hyper-0x is Buckleson’s in-house blockchain for verification, audit, and settlement. It creates tamper-evident execution records so approved events can be traced without claiming that a model response itself is true.

  • Verifiable execution records
  • Audit and settlement support
  • Designed for: quantum-resistant architecture and four-layer encryption
  • Designed for: EVM, Solana, and Sui interoperability
  • Designed for: account abstraction, task side-chains, and high-velocity finality
